title: Escalation-criteria checklist
description: The escalation-criteria checklist: each criterion box marked suspected or confirmed, the decision under the E rule, the closure check and the default clocks.

checkedByInWhich.x-assured-prompt: Checked by, in which phase, at
checkedByInWhich.description: Checked by, in which phase, at (UTC)

confirmedMalicious.x-assured-section: 1. Confirmed malicious activity not fully contained by a control

verifiedMaliciousInfrastructure.x-assured-checkbox: Verified malicious infrastructure: IPs or domains tied to known C2 (command and control), phishing, or attacker infrastructure in threat-intelligence sources, corroborated by host or identity telemetry showing what the connection did (a listing alone is a lead)

malwareIndicators.x-assured-checkbox: Malware indicators: file hashes matching documented malware or unauthorized tools with verified malicious functionality, plus a second source showing the file ran or was staged to run

exploitationEvidence.x-assured-checkbox: Exploitation evidence: attacker tools or exploits executed, consistent with known malware families or attacker profiles

attAndCkMappedBehavior.x-assured-checkbox: ATT&CK-mapped behavior outside any sanctioned change, in tactics such as privilege escalation, persistence, or defense impairment (ATT&CK v19), corroborated by an independent source (benign administration maps to ATT&CK routinely; the mapping names the behavior, it does not prove malice)

productionSystemsDirectlySupportingReven.x-assured-checkbox: Production systems directly supporting revenue or customer experience

regulatedDataRepositories.x-assured-checkbox: Regulated data repositories: personally identifiable information (PII), protected health information (PHI), or payment card data (mandatory breach-notification clocks may apply)

cloudInfrastructureHostingCriticalWorklo.x-assured-checkbox: Cloud infrastructure hosting critical workloads, especially with privileged access or broad connections to organizational data

identityAndAccessInfrastructure.x-assured-checkbox: Identity and access infrastructure: domain controllers, identity providers (IdPs), public key infrastructure (PKI), secrets management, VPN and remote-access gateways

securityAndRecoveryInfrastructure.x-assured-checkbox: Security and recovery infrastructure: endpoint detection and response (EDR), security information and event management (SIEM), backup consoles (tampering blinds detection or removes the ability to recover)

systemsWhoseDisruptionCausesSubstantial.x-assured-checkbox: Systems whose disruption causes substantial operational, financial, or reputational harm

attackerDrivenExpansion.x-assured-checkbox: Attacker-driven expansion: the activity has reached a second host, account, or service beyond the original subject, and the benign explanations for the hop (sanctioned administration, automation) have been ruled out

dataStagingObserved.x-assured-checkbox: Data staging observed: unusual or password-protected archives, collection folders, large internal transfers

outboundTransferToExternalOr.x-assured-checkbox: Outbound transfer to external or anomalous destinations, measured against the host's own baseline, especially destinations the organization does not sanction

credentialDumpingFollowedByCredential.x-assured-checkbox: Credential dumping followed by credential use, or credential use that crosses a trust boundary (new segment, new tenant, new privilege tier)

multipleHostsOrUsersShowing.x-assured-checkbox: Multiple hosts or users showing the same or related activity

theSameLure.x-assured-checkbox: The same lure, infrastructure, or artifact appearing across teams or business units

aPasswordSprayThatProduced.x-assured-checkbox: A password spray that produced at least one successful authentication, or that targets the organization specifically (custom username lists, your naming convention)

variantChurn.x-assured-checkbox: Variant churn: the same behavior from samples with different hashes on multiple hosts within days

externalIntelligenceReportingAnActive.x-assured-checkbox: External intelligence reporting an active campaign targeting the organization or sector, matched to a local artifact (an indicator, lure, or technique seen here), not the report alone

coordinatedTimingThatSuggestsAn.x-assured-checkbox: Coordinated timing that suggests an operator, not an opportunistic one-off

x-assured-instructions: Any box CONFIRMED, in any phase

cellRecorded.description: Cell recorded (impact / likelihood, with confidence beside it), and the reasoning

regulatoryFlagsAndCandidateAwareness.x-assured-checkbox: Regulatory flags and candidate awareness timestamps recorded; owners engaged.

noEscalationCriterionConfirmed.x-assured-checkbox: No escalation criterion confirmed, or open as a suspicion

theCellAllowsIt.x-assured-checkbox: The cell allows it: P4, or a P3 whose named re-score trigger came back clean

noPersistenceOrCredentialAccess.x-assured-checkbox: No persistence or credential access observed in the evidence examined

theCaseSOwnAlternatives.x-assured-checkbox: The case's own alternatives checked clean

gapsBounded.x-assured-checkbox: Gaps bounded: each named, with the reopen triggers written down
